messages:
erin: Heads-up: multiple folks hit friction today when rotating keys during a deployment. The root cause seems to be a mix of env var names + unclear rotation contract in SDKs. Can we agree on a small, backwards-compatible plan?
kai: saw that too. customers hit 401s and the logs just said "unauthorized". no hint about scope vs expiry. painful in prod. :sweat_smile:
jas: proposal: canonical env vars: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_PROJECT (optional), REDWOOD_REFRESH. SDKs should accept legacy names (RW_API_KEY, RED_KEY) but emit a single-process deprecation notice with a link. keep the wording short.
mika: agree. for rotation flow: SDK tries the following on auth failure: 1) if REDWOOD_REFRESH present, attempt a single refresh exchange, 2) if exchange succeeds, retry the original request once, 3) otherwise return a machine-friendly error. no silent retries for non-idempotent ops.
erin: machine-friendly error example (snake_case): \n```\ncode: auth_key_invalid\nhttp_status: 401\nretryable: false\nsuggested_action: rotate_api_key_or_refresh\nhelp_url: https://redwood.dev/docs/auth/errors#auth_key_invalid\n```\nInclude that as structured metadata on the error object in each SDK.
kai: also add a small runtime hint when scopes mismatch: one-line log: "scope mismatch: key_org=acme-stg, req_org=acme-prod; consider REDWOOD_PROJECT or a request-scoped key". Emit at most once per process for noisy workloads.
jas: CLI UX: when `rw` detects key expiry within 72h, prompt interactively: "API key expires in 48h. Rotate now? (y/N)". Add `--yes` or `--ci` flags to skip prompt in automation. CLI should also offer `rw auth rotate --preview` to show what will change.
mika: sample apps: include a small Go example showing the refresh hook and set_key call. makes it clear for platform engineers.
erin: retries: backoff tiny, max attempts 2 total. only retry after successful refresh. document idempotency expectations.
ops-bot: filed ticket DEVEX-322 to standardize vars, DEVEX-323 for structured error spec, assigned to jas and kai.
kai: next steps: jas drafts the error payload and SDK interface, mika writes CLI prompts and sample app. erin will consolidate into a single PR for each language.
jas: one more thing: state the exact key discovery precedence in docs: 1) explicit constructor param, 2) REDWOOD_API_KEY env, 3) ~/.redwood/credentials, 4) platform metadata. makes debugging reproducible.
erin: great. aiming to land this week. thanks team :tada:
